ui.devtools.click-a-row-to-see-details: Click a row to see its input, output, and timing.
ui.devtools.content-truncated: Content is too long; only the first part is shown.
ui.devtools.diagnostic-logs-are-off: Diagnostic logs are off, so process I/O was not recorded. Turn them on in Settings → Privacy & Permissions; later turns will be recorded.
ui.devtools.no-body-recorded-for-this-re: No body for this request: bodies are recorded only while diagnostic logs are on, and kept for 24 hours.
ui.devtools.no-gateway-requests-in-this-: No gateway model requests in this turn.
ui.devtools.no-gateway-requests-official: No gateway model requests in this turn (with an official account, the coding agent connects to the official service directly).
ui.devtools.no-input-or-output-was-kept: No input or output was kept for this call (older messages keep only an outline).
ui.devtools.no-process-records-in-this-t: No process records in this turn.
ui.devtools.no-steps-in-this-turn: No thinking, tool calls, or gateway requests in this turn.
